status: isolated prototype; not production Tilemap collision

methodology.cellUnits: integer cell ranges, each body queries side*side cells; no Camera or renderer
methodology.patterns: uniform=all Solid; scattered=deterministic coordinate hash modulo 8
methodology.identity: all strategies enumerate semantic cell IDs after geometry search; checksums/hit counts asserted equal each pass; exact sets checked in unit tests
methodology.timing: one pass over all actor footprints; edit+index commit and search+cell enumeration separated; excludes input Grid generation, production policy/filter/narrow phase/solver/pair events
methodology.percentiles: p50 ordinary median, p95 nearest-rank ceil(.95*n)-1; raw values retained
methodology.rawFormat: Raw per-pass samples grouped by workload after measurement; original floating-point values preserved. Summary uses ordinary median / nearest-rank p95.

limitations: Shared Linux host / Node JIT, not real-time FPS or browser/hardware claim
One map, static axis-aligned boolean cells, footprint axis-aligned boxes, no mixed policies
Merged is greedy row-run + spatial buckets, not globally optimal rectangle cover; chunked merges inside 16x16 chunks
Per-cell identity enumeration prevents claiming rectangle count alone as whole-system cost
No native memory/GC bytes, long soak, full terrain physics or GPU work measured
